app.name: Nidaan
app.tagline: AI-Powered Prescription Scanner & Generic Drug Alternative Finder for Bangladesh
app.disclaimer: Medical Disclaimer: Nidaan is an informational AI tool. Never substitute or change prescribed medications without consulting a registered doctor or licensed pharmacist.

home.heroDesc: Scan handwritten or printed doctor prescriptions. Our AI reads complex medical handwriting, maps medicines to Bangladeshi generics, and discovers certified, lower-cost brand alternatives.
home.howItWorksSubtitle: From handwritten doctor's slip to affordable generic alternatives in 3 simple steps
home.step1Desc: Take a photo or upload an image of your prescription. Our preprocessor auto-enhances contrast and detects blur.
home.step2Desc: TrOCR and clinical NLP detect medicines, strength, and dosage. Review items with interactive zoom & pan alignment.
home.step3Desc: Instantly see certified generic equivalents from top Bangladeshi pharma companies with transparent price comparisons.
home.feature1Desc: Trained on complex doctor handwriting styles, clinical shorthand (Rx, BD, TDS), and bilingual instructions.
home.feature2Desc: Comprehensive coverage of Square, Beximco, Incepta, Renata, Healthcare, Eskayef, ACI, and Aristopharma.
home.feature3Desc: Intelligent Trigram and Levenshtein similarity algorithm matches misread characters to valid drug brands.
home.feature4Desc: Clear breakdown of unit price, pack price, and total savings per course duration (7 days, 1 month, 3 months).

results.disclaimerBoxText: In Bangladesh, medicines sharing the exact same Generic Name, Strength, and Dosage Form contain identical active pharmaceutical ingredients approved by the Directorate General of Drug Administration (DGDA). However, always show these alternatives to your registered physician or dispensing pharmacist before making any substitution.
